title: P6-09: Threat Intelligence: Google sign-in on the new Cognito domain (same Google client), secrets, editors
description:
## Goal
The live Threat Intelligence content is copied from the legacy backend (dzefa11i80jyq) to the new one with proven fidelity, and the new app matches the P6-01 baseline.

## Context (FACT, read-only 2026-10-10)
- Source: stack amplify-dzefa11i80jyq-main-branch-a099beb80d (AppSync otvp3nyxcff7rluvi2jfkf7vzq, pool us-east-1_t1A6sJX55), the LEGACY copy of the new template app, already converted to bodyMarkus/bodyIr (PPY-301b12). Rows: Edition 1, PublishedEdition 1, EditionItem 18, PublishedEditionItem 18, Item 20 (18 published + 2 private doctrine), PublishedItem 18, MediaAsset 24, PublishedMediaAsset 24, NewsroomSection 6, Tag 8, ItemTag 24 = 162 rows; all other tables 0.
- Source media bucket amplify-dzefa11i80jyq-mai-papyrusmediabucket0dab24-bxtjtqk3sahh: 65 objects, 160,572,044 bytes, all under media/ (14 mp4 including two 26 MB edition videos, svg).
- Research/knowledge data (Reference 1866, SemanticRelation 3258, SemanticNode 387, Message 907, ...; corpora 409 objects, 88 MB) lives only in the OLD inert backend of d3on1y5vlrxmam and stays ARCHIVE-ONLY (Ryan 2026-10-07): it is not copied; P6-13 verifies an archive exists before the old backend is deleted.
- Tool: `papyrus ops content copy-backend` with `--source-profile legacy --target-profile papyrus-production --expect-source-account 335163751677 --expect-target-account 712236451410 --models Edition,PublishedEdition,EditionItem,PublishedEditionItem,Item,PublishedItem,MediaAsset,PublishedMediaAsset,NewsroomSection,Tag,ItemTag --s3-prefixes media/ --s3-transfer stream` (dry run default; `--apply`; re-run idempotent; ids, slugs, versionNumber, publishedAt and S3 keys preserved; multipart ETags reproduced with the stream mode).
- Baseline to use: /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/threat-intelligence-20261007/ (models/content-manifest.json, s3/media-manifest.json, checksums) and the P6-01 re-run; scripts take a BASE and the table/bucket constants to point at the new backend.

## Exact steps
1. Dry run: all 11 models create = counts above, 0 invalid, 65 media objects missing. Review with Ryan.
2. Ryan yes, freeze editing in the legacy newsroom, apply; re-run reports zero changes.
3. Fidelity: counts; per-row manifests equal (excluding timestamps, owner and identity fields); S3 key/size/ETag equal for 65; sha256 byte-compare of the two 26 MB videos and 10 random objects; convert-bodies check that bodyMarkus/bodyIr are present on all 18 PublishedItem rows (no re-conversion).
4. Run the P6-01 site scripts against the new app's default URL: 24 routes status equal; visible-text hash equal on `/`, the edition and the 18 articles; 404 probes equal; 120 screenshots median pixel diff ratio at the 0.0006 order and equal page heights; /newsroom differs only as it did in the 2026-10-08 run; article video readyState 4, `/api/media` 307 then 206 on the presigned URL.
5. Source row counts and S3 bytes unchanged before and after.

## Acceptance checks
- All of step 3 to 5 pass; zero errors; nothing printed that is secret.

## Rollback
Delete the copied rows/objects or the stack (Ryan); the legacy backend is untouched.

## Risks
Edits in the legacy newsroom during the window (delta at cutover); SSO expiry (idempotent); Pretext raw HTML is not stable between requests (use text and DOM hashes, as the baseline README says).

## Needs Ryan
Dry-run review, apply yes, freeze.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under /Users/home/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
right_now_summary: The team is preparing Google sign-in, secrets, and editor access on the new Cognito domain.
